neighbours.label: The opening piece of a katakana word that the tokenizer splits into several pieces, loanword or native (e.g. ア in アドレナリン, ト in トンボ), in Japanese or mixed text. Quiet for common katakana words that are a single whole token (e.g. テレビ), and for hiragana or kanji words in the same slot. Weaker (about 0.2-0.45 of max) on English loanwords spelled in Korean Hangul.
